headline: GameStop (GME) Disclosed A Stake In A Major Online Marketplace
summary: GameStop (NYSE:GME) has disclosed a new equity stake in eBay alongside a sharper push into collectibles and trading cards. The retailer reports that collectibles now represent a substantial share of its sales as it reallocates floor space away from physical games. A recently expanded trading card partnership is intended to deepen GameStop's presence in higher margin hobby and memorabilia categories.
